summary.text: Rebecca Reimer is a Republican state representative from South Dakota's District 26B, in office since 2018, who is running for the State Senate in District 26 rather than seeking re-election to the House.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and faces Democrat Shawn Bordeaux in the November 3 general election.

paragraphs.text: Reimer has served on the House Judiciary Committee in each session listed by Ballotpedia from 2019 through 2026.
Her other assignments have included the Education and Local Government committees in 2019-2020, the State Affairs Committee in 2021-2024, and the Health and Human Services Committee in 2025-2026.
